items.docs: Update the action for a specific rule you want to evaluate. Like your current rules, actions are `alert` to record the trigger of the event, `deny` to block the request, or `none` to take no action. This applies to both ASE auto and ASE manual upgrade modes. You may need additional permissions to add or update rule actions in `ASE_AUTO` mode. _Products:_ Kona Site Defender, App & API Protector with the Advanced Security module.
